text:
Aisha Khan: Hey team — running a 6-week POC with NimbusHealth (healthcare startup). They want a temporary per-unit price of $0.0006/token for the pilot (projected ~30M tokens) and want the monthly billing floor removed for the first month. Can deals desk approve a short-term tweak?
Tom Rivera: Thanks Aisha. Do we have expected spend profile across weeks? Is this billed hosted API only (no Private)?
Aisha Khan: Hosted API only. Estimate: week1 2M, week2-5 ~7M/week, week6 0.5M (spikes daily). They signed an MSA but not a committed spend.
Priya Desai: 30M tokens x $0.0006 = $18k. With our standard tiered pricing they'd be ~ $0.0009/token => ~$27k. So discount request ~33%. Why remove billing floor?
Aisha Khan: They said finance can't pre-commit yet due to SOC request timing; pilot needs no min charge so they can pause after month 1 if legal stalls.
Miguel Ortiz: Any infra concerns? Continuous bursts ~7M tokens/wk is fine, but we should pin them to a single region. Also they want streaming which adds concurrency — need quota bump on host.
Tom Rivera: Two options: 1) Temporary promotional override for one billing cycle (rate $0.0006) with no floor, or 2) Offer a small commitment (e.g., $25k net for 30 days) in exchange for $0.0006 and keep floor. Which does sales prefer?
Aisha Khan: Prefer option 1 to avoid forcing commitment. This is a high-strategic healthcare reference.
Priya Desai: Finance prefers a short commitment when possible. We can accept option 1 if Revenue Ops signs off on risk. Need approval from Deals Desk lead.
Tom Rivera: @Priya Desai @Miguel Ortiz I'll open a deals desk ticket and propose a 30-day override with these controls:
```
- rate_override: 0.0006 per token
- duration: 30d from invoice date
- floor: waived for invoice 1 only
- cap: $35,000 hard stop (auto-throttle, notify sales)
- region: us-west-2 only
```
Tom Rivera: Also suggest auto-throttle integration so we don't exceed capacity or unexpected spend.
Miguel Ortiz: Cap + region pinning + throttle good. I'll queue a quota bump for the stream concurrency.
BillingBot: New deals-desk request created: DD-2026-214. Current status: pending_review.
Priya Desai: For approvals we'll need: customer legal sign-off date, use-case (PHI? pseudonymized?), and contact in their finance team. Aisha can you supply?
Aisha Khan: On it — legal says they'll share SOC2 scope by Friday. Contact: jen.harding@nimbushealth.com. Use-case: clinical triage assistant (PHI will not be sent; they plan to pseudonymize).
Tom Rivera: I'm annotating the ticket with those details and recommending approval with the $35k cap and 30d override. If legal shows PHI flows later we revoke override.
Priya Desai: Sounds good. Approver: @Tom Rivera (Deals Desk) to mark final once SOC2 scope is validated.
Miguel Ortiz: FYI I'll add tagging so we can trace usage back to the POC for cost attribution.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team! Will follow up after SOC2 scope comes in. :thumbsup:
Tom Rivera: I'll update DD-2026-214 later today. Please react in-thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
